name: How to play
notes: The controls and what there is to do.

lines.speaker: HOW TO PLAY
lines.text: D-PAD WALKS, HOLD B TO RUN. A TALKS, PICKS UP AND USES THE TOOL IN YOUR HANDS. L / R CHANGE THE TOOL: HANDS, SHOVEL, NET, ROD. START OPENS THE MENU.

lines.speaker: HOW TO PLAY
lines.text: HANDS SHAKE APPLE TREES. THE SHOVEL DIGS STAR CRACKS AND HITS ROCKS. THE NET CATCHES BUGS. THE ROD (BRAMBLE SELLS IT) CATCHES FISH: CAST AT A SHADOW, WAIT, PULL WHEN IT SPLASHES.

lines.speaker: HOW TO PLAY
lines.text: SELL TO BRAMBLE, DONATE TO PROF. ODESSA AND PAY YOUR LOAN TO MAYOR ARDEA. SLEEP IN YOUR BED TO SAVE AND START A NEW DAY.
